full_prompt_en: A square folk-art illustration centers a dark-haired girl against an extraordinarily dense floral field. Her face is frontal and calm, with a long slender neck, broad dark eyes, small red lips, and round warm-coral cheeks. Black hair is parted precisely down the middle and framed by a scalloped ochre-orange band. Her dark garment carries delicate gold and teal embroidered motifs around the neckline and across the chest. To the right, a black bird perches beside her shoulder, its feathers etched with small gray marks. A large ribbed orange pumpkin fills the lower-right corner. Every gap around the figure is occupied by stylized flowers, leaves, round seed heads, tendrils, and jewel-like dots. A large turquoise radial blossom opens near the upper right, balanced by smaller orange circular blooms on the left. Dark teal and black fill the background between these forms, making the warm face and pumpkin glow. The shapes have firm contour lines and repeated internal patterning, with tiny stipple and hatch marks giving a tactile printed surface. The composition is nearly symmetrical around the face but becomes deliberately uneven through the bird and pumpkin. Light is flat and decorative rather than naturalistic; contrasts come mainly from color placement and dark outlines. The palette is disciplined despite its density: burnt orange, turquoise, dark teal, ochre, black, and pale cream. No realistic scenery or text appears. The whole image feels intimate, mysterious, and abundant, like a carefully ornamented folk tale page whose quiet central expression steadies the restless patterned surround.
full_prompt_zh: 一幅方形民间艺术插画把一位黑发女孩置于异常密集的花卉色场中央。她的脸正面而平静，脖子细长，深色眼睛宽大，嘴唇小而红，双颊圆润暖珊瑚色。黑发精确中分，由波浪边赭橙发带围住。深色衣服在领口和胸前带细巧金色与绿松石刺绣图案。右侧，一只黑鸟停在肩旁，羽毛上有小灰线刻纹。右下角一只大型条棱橙南瓜填满边角。人物周围每处空隙都被程式化花、叶、圆籽头、卷须和宝石般小点占据。右上开着一朵大型绿松石放射花，左侧较小的橙色圆花与之平衡。深蓝绿与黑填住这些形体之间的背景，让暖色脸和南瓜发光。形状有明确轮廓线与重复内部花纹，细小点描和排线使表面像有触感的印刷。构图以脸为轴近乎对称，却被鸟与南瓜有意打破。光是平面装饰性而非自然主义；对比主要来自颜色位置与深轮廓。虽密集，调色仍严格：焦橙、绿松石、深蓝绿、赭黄、黑和淡奶油色。没有真实布景或文字。整幅图亲密、神秘且丰盛，像被细心装饰的民间故事页，安静中央表情稳住躁动纹样周围。
style_prompt_en: Dense folk-art illustration fills nearly every gap with firm dark contours, radial motifs, curling organic shapes, and tiny repeated interior marks. Burnt orange, turquoise, dark teal, ochre, black, and pale cream form a jewel-like but controlled palette. A smooth warm central area is held against a dark patterned field, while larger circular accents establish a measured beat among many small dots and leaves. Fine stippling, hatching, and embroidered-looking lines give the otherwise flat shapes a tactile printed finish. Illumination stays decorative and even, relying on color contrast instead of natural cast shadows. Approximate symmetry provides calm, and a few unequal side accents keep the richly packed square from becoming rigid.
style_prompt_zh: 密集民间艺术插画用明确深轮廓、放射纹样、卷曲有机形和细小重复内部笔痕填满几乎每个空隙。焦橙、绿松石、深蓝绿、赭黄、黑与淡奶油形成宝石般却受控的调色。平滑暖色中央区域面对深色花纹场，较大的圆形点色在许多小点和叶形之间建立有节奏的拍点。细点描、排线和近似刺绣的线让其他较平的形状获得有触感的印刷表面。照明保持装饰性而均匀，依靠色彩对比而非自然投影。近似对称提供平静，少量不等侧边点色又防止密集方形变得僵硬。
theme_en: A calm dark-haired girl surrounded by patterned flowers and a black bird
theme_zh: 平静的黑发女孩被花纹花草与一只黑鸟围绕
name: Julie Paschkis
reuse_rule: Use style_prompt_en/zh for transferable visual style. Full prompts and themes are examples of the original scene, not content to carry into a new user theme.
